# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Paladin level 8 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Paladin
# level-1..level-7 hybrid chassis baseline to level 8 as chosen input only.
# It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat), the deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield /
# Power Attack posture, and the level-3..level-7 fixture's
# choice=choice:paladin_mercy selection (mercy:shaken) unchanged -- Mercy is
# granted once, at 3rd level, and stays granted (not re-derived) at 8th
# level; the PF1 CRB level-8 "Special" column reads "Aura of resolve" only
# (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com) -- the
# next repeat Mercy grant does not land until 9th level, so this fixture
# deliberately does not add a second mercy selection.
#
# Aura of Resolve (immunity to charm spells and spell-like abilities, plus a
# +4 morale bonus against charm effects for allies within 10 feet while the
# paladin is conscious) was checked rather than assumed away and confirmed
# NOT flat/identity-shaped: it needs a condition-immunity engine and an
# ally-aura/positional engine, neither of which exists in this codebase --
# exactly like Aura of Courage (3rd) and Divine Health (3rd) before it, it
# stays deliberately named-but-unproven and this fixture makes no
# aura-of-resolve claim either way.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell
# selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no mercy EFFECT
# resolution, no channel positive energy healing/damage-resolution execution,
# no Divine Bond (weapon bond / mount bond) selection or execution, and no
# alignment-target or healing-resource accounting, and no level-9+
# progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-paladin-level8
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:paladin:8
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:diplomacy:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
choice=choice:paladin_mercy:mercy:shaken
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
